interest: Shows 1934 New Zealand alarm over Japan importing flax plants to build its own cordage industry.
overview: Wellington report: Japan ordered 40,000 New Zealand flax plants, with 100,000 more possible, stirring New Zealand and Australian concern over aiding a future export competitor in cordage.
